# Will an S3 lifecycle rule actually save money?

> Paste an S3 Inventory CSV and see current monthly cost by storage class and the net 12-month saving of moving objects to Standard-IA, Glacier or Intelligent-Tiering after transition fees, minimum sizes, minimum durations and retrieval. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
